title: Best Portrait and Caricature Artists (2026): Custom Drawings
description: How to hire a portrait or caricature artist for gifts, profiles or brands: photos to send, styles, how to brief it, what drives the price and red flags.
intro: Portrait and caricature artists draw people from photos: realistic portraits, digital paintings, line art or funny caricatures with exaggerated features. They are popular as gifts, profile pictures, wedding art and team illustrations. Projects go wrong when photos are too dark or small, the style is not agreed, or a caricature exaggerates in a way the person dislikes. This guide helps you get a portrait people are happy to keep.

faq.a: Clear, well-lit, high-resolution photos with the face visible. Several photos from different angles help the artist capture the likeness.

faq.q: Can the artist combine several photos?
faq.a: Usually yes, for example people photographed separately. It takes more work, so it may cost more.
It should not be. Tell the artist which features to keep subtle and what tone you want: friendly, playful or bold.
Ask for a high-resolution file sized for your print. A small file will look blurry on a large canvas.

faq.q: Can I use it as a logo or business image?
faq.a: Agree on commercial use in writing if the portrait will represent a business or be sold on products.
